overlap.comparison: Its relative-mesh theorem gives eventual existence in the pure fine case k=0 under a sequence hypothesis. It does not give these uniform finite thresholds, the nearest-base ordinary-centroid witness, or the rank-one width specialization.

summary: The exact prescribed nearest-base rounded centroid is feasible under the first mesh bound and has the claimed sharp-target depth under the second. The rank-one projection condition and numerical 1024 specialization follow.
